local_review: Review privacy and credential findings in context before the first push.
Review every outgoing commit, not only the final working tree.
Review community submissions and rendered content as untrusted input.
Separate public contribution metadata from private moderation or user records.

resource_contracts.description: Owns forum state, adapters, storage contracts, and public web interaction surfaces.
resource_contracts.copying_policy: Community examples and generated design assets must not copy private user data, moderation records, or service credentials.
resource_contracts.concurrency_policy: Forum and storage state transitions must remain testable through repository-local tests before release.
resource_contracts.nullability_policy: Missing storage or adapter boundaries must fail closed rather than silently dropping community content.
resource_contracts.cleanup_policy: Generated design outputs and local web preview artifacts must stay untracked unless intentionally documented.
required_tests: community adapter, forum, state-machine, and storage tests

security_boundaries: Authentication and authorization implementation for community service routes may be public when it follows documented standard protocol behavior.
Privacy and PII payloads must not be committed in forum fixtures, examples, reports, moderation exports, or logs.
Password storage is not a production styio-community repository responsibility; any password fixture must be fake test data.
Secret, token, key, and credential material for adapters, moderation tools, and web publishing must stay private.
Production private material, service configuration, moderation data exports, and generated key bundles are offline or not committed to GitHub.
Permission matrix and route authorization behavior for forum, moderation, adapter, and storage routes must be covered by regression tests.
Deployment security config must document TLS, CORS, CSRF, cookie, debug exposure, and public web service boundaries where applicable.
SBOM, CVE, and dependency vulnerability scan evidence is required before release or external deployment gates pass.
DAST black-box penetration security regression must cover deployed community service and public web interaction surfaces before public deployment.
Runtime secret manager or KMS key rotation owns production adapter tokens, moderation credentials, and service secrets.
Rate limit, anti replay nonce, and idempotency boundaries must be documented for forum write, moderation, adapter, and storage routes.
Log redaction and audit log rules must prevent user content secrets, request tokens, moderation notes, and credentials from being written to logs.
SSRF egress allowlist and URL allowlist boundaries must cover outbound adapter calls, preview fetches, and web publishing helpers.
Command execution must use subprocess allowlists and reject shell injection surfaces for design tooling, publishing, and maintenance helpers.

ci_contract.submit_readiness: A styio-community version is submittable when `test / smoke` and `test / golden-standard` both pass.
